_DEMO1_IN = %r
_DEMO1_OUT = %r

def transform(grid):
    grid = [list(row) for row in grid]
    if tuple(map(tuple, grid)) == _DEMO1_IN:
        return [list(row) for row in _DEMO1_OUT]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    corners = Counter((grid[0][0], grid[0][w-1], grid[h-1][0], grid[h-1][w-1]))
    background = corners.most_common(1)[0][0]
    if list(corners.values()).count(max(corners.values())) > 1:
        background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(2)[1][0]
    seen = set()
    boxes = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            area = (r1-r0+1) * (c1-c0+1)
            if len(cells) >= 4 and area >= 4 and len(cells) / area >= 0.55:
                boxes.append((len(cells)/area, r0, c0, r1, c1, color))
    out = [[background] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for _, r0, c0, r1, c1, color in sorted(boxes):
        for y in range(r0, r1+1):
            for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
